keep_playing_why: Game A gave me a real read-and-decide loop within the first minute: storm cells that zap or charge you depending on when you couch, reach and ram bands, and a different counter for each rival, so I played differently by minute five. Game B showed a guided gust chain with one obvious action per step in the 125 s I got (harness-limited, partial session), so the margin rests on what I saw, not on a full 540 s of B.
better_made_why: A is clear, loud and dramatic with crunchy hits and thunder, but its pause menu is visibly broken, there are blank frames, and the result text does not say what to fix. B is the prettier painterly build with good intro writing, but it wedged me on planters and fence ends, bounced me back off ledges and swung the camera under my stick, so a thumb would struggle to find the path. Close, and B's session was cut short.
